seoTitle: CSS Button Generator: Hover, Active and Focus States
metaDescription: Design a button with padding, colours, border, radius, shadow and font, set hover and active colours, and copy the CSS. Free.
intro: Builds button CSS with separate hover, active, focus-visible and disabled states and a live preview.
why:
A button needs more than a background colour: hover, pressed, keyboard focus and disabled all need to look right.

This tool writes all of those states, uses :focus-visible so keyboard users see an outline without mouse clicks adding one, and adds a reduced-motion override for the transition. Pick colours with enough contrast: the text colour against each background should reach at least 4.5 to 1.
howTo: Set colours, border, radius, padding and font.
Try the preview with mouse and keyboard.

faq.a: It shows the outline for keyboard focus but not for mouse clicks, which is what most designers want.
No. Use the contrast checker with your chosen colours.

faq.q: Can I use it for links?
faq.a: Yes, apply the class to an a element, but keep real buttons for actions.
